page_note: Overwhelmingly substrate. The page is a continuous cosmological narrative organized by 'watches' (ⲣⲱϣⲉ) of cosmic figures — Great King of Glory/Counsel of the wheels, Omophoros (depths of the Deep), Pherrokatochos (Pillar of Glory), Great King of Honor (Egregoroi bound in prison of darkness), and Adamas (abortions begetting Adam and Eve, Jesus and the Five Sons). The structural unit boundaries align with cosmic-watch transitions. The only editorial seam is in segs 5-6 where the abortions' filling of the world with desire is extended into contemporary persecution: 'they persecute the churches; they kill the apostles' — application of the cosmic narrative to Manichaean church history. The closing 'place of battle of Adam of Light, time after time, generation after generation' returns to cosmic register. Heavy lacunae (58.3%) but structure is clear.
